## Summary Crypto sits in a digital land of its own over the internet. Without being explicit about what jurisdiction it is in, it will get absorbed and claimed by current jurisdictions and regulators. ## Questions for Exploration - What gives regulators authority? - Sovereignty: what is it and how can we achieve it leveraging technologies and systems of law. - Regulation and jurisdiction, where blockchains and cryptocurrency stand legally. Is decentralisation the only tool and defence humanity has from tyranny?; - Also, how can digital assets be defined from the perspective of ownership, licensing and intellectual property? How can we create systems that reward creators and inventors, protect them and incentivise innovation?; - How can decentralized digital networks and technologies interface in the physical world?
